verdict.rationale: Llama offers ingredients for agent use: function calling and agent-optimized inference since Llama 3.1, weights in Hugging Face transformers format, llama.cpp support, and hosting on major clouds and inference providers. llama.com also carries a one-line mention of "Multi-agent coding in your terminal", with no detail on what it is or how it connects. Missing for 10: documented official integrations with named coding agents or agent frameworks, official skills/plugins, a first-party agent SDK, and independent corroboration of agent-framework plug-in workflows.
